name: Area chart
for: A metrics card in a product or infrastructure section: one metric over 14 days, a crisp accent line over a soft accent fade, the chart's own grid, and a reading for any day by pointer or arrow keys.
how: 'fade' is plain CSS: the area under the line fades from the accent to the card. 'ruled-grounds' masks a still accent dot ruling to the area (an SVG mask of the area path and a top-to-bottom fade). The line is a plain SVG path on top. Pointer and arrow keys read each day; the tooltip is pinned inside the plot beside the point.
rules: Real numbers (invented ones are covered by the page's one placeholder note, never a sample tag in the chart); axis labels on the data's own scale.
The fill stays inside the area, never behind the labels, and is still: no moving traces, no pulses.
The chart has one grid, its own; never an effect that draws a second one (grid-pulse) or a tone that runs across the frame (halftone-screen leaves half the area empty).
a11y: The plot is a focusable image with a label; arrow keys, Home and End read each day into a polite live region; a hidden table holds all values.
